description: Data source configuration for the Zepto AI Review Engine. Each source has a priority tier, target apps or communities, and configuration parameters. Sources are scraped in tier order — Tier 1 sources must succeed before Tier 2 is attempted.

priority_tiers.tier_1: Required. Pipeline does not proceed without at least one Tier 1 source.
priority_tiers.tier_2: Recommended. Adds corpus diversity but not blocking.
priority_tiers.tier_3: Optional. High cost or low ROI — only enable if Tier 1+2 corpus is thin.

ingestion.notes: start_date and end_date define the collection window. 'current' means today. max_documents_per_source of -1 means unlimited. lookback_months is a fallback if end_date is 'current'.

sources.name: Google Play Store
sources.notes: No API key required. Uses google-play-scraper library. Rate limiting is implicit — add 1–2 second delay between requests. Date filtering is applied post-scrape since the library does not support server-side date range queries.

sources.name: Apple App Store
sources.notes: Uses app-store-scraper library. Indian iOS user base is smaller than Android. Expect lower volume than Play Store. Date filtering is applied post-scrape.

sources.name: Quora Discussions
sources.notes: Publicly accessible discussions. HTML scraping via BeautifulSoup. Quora may rate-limit or block automated requests — use delays between requests. Date filtering is applied post-scrape.

sources.name: Public Blogs
sources.notes: Optional Tier 3 source. Blog content is long-form and may contain qualitative insights. HTML structure varies widely across blogs.

sources.name: Product Review Websites
sources.notes: Optional Tier 3 source. Product review sites may have structured review data with ratings and dates.

sources.name: Community Forums
sources.notes: Enabled for the initial corpus build. HTML structure changes frequently, so verify selectors before running.

sources.name: Twitter / X
sources.notes: Disabled by default. Requires TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN and TWITTER_ENABLED=true in .env. Tier 3 — short-form content has low signal density for this use case.

sources.name: CSV Uploads
sources.notes: For survey responses, interview transcripts, and manually collected community discussions. Place CSV files in data/csv_uploads/ before running ingestion. Unlimited documents by default.

data_schema.description: Canonical schema produced by every connector. All fields are required unless marked nullable.

text.note: Raw review or post body. Must be non-empty after UTF-8 decoding.

rating.note: Null for forum posts, blog posts, and Twitter tweets

created_at.note: Original publication date from the source

url.note: Source URL linking to the original review or post

language.note: BCP 47 language code detected at ingestion (e.g., 'en', 'hi')

platform.note: The platform where the feedback was collected

metadata.note: Source-specific fields: app_id, thread_title, tweet_id, etc.
